title: Uncertainty over Income Tax Treatments
summary: Addresses how to account for uncertainty over income tax treatments under IAS 12, requiring entities to reflect the effect of uncertainty using either the most likely amount method or the expected value method.

related.title: Income Taxes
related.relationship: The parent standard IFRIC 23 interprets, supplying the overall current and deferred tax accounting framework

related.title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
related.relationship: Deliberately not applied to uncertain tax treatments — IAS 12's own measurement framework governs this area

related.title: Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors
related.relationship: Governs whether a change in an uncertain tax position estimate is treated as a change in accounting estimate
